result.topic_en: A short German note on the crystal prism fitted to telescopes, saying it lengthens them by about one third of the prism's side but slightly disturbs perfect colourlessness (achromatism).
result.transcription:
Das Krystallprisma an den Fernröhren vergroßert deren
Länge etwa um $\frac{1}{3}$ der Seite des Prisma; stört aber etwas
die vollkommene Farbenlosigkeit.

methods.what: Empirical rule: the crystal prism increases the effective length of a telescope by about one third of the prism's side
methods.quote:

items.english: The crystal prism on telescopes increases their length by about 1/3 of the side of the prism, but somewhat disturbs the perfect colourlessness.
